findings.title: `drive_waivable_outstanding` reads `$paths` unset when the verify log has no prestate snapshot, aborting the classifier under `set -u` and killing the flaky/pin routes (Part Y5 fails)
the stale-pin route is still proved from post-run worktree state, so a verification command can manufacture the waiver the prestate binding closed for the exec-bit and build-state routes
`tests/run.sh` and `scripts/ci-local.sh` now discard a passing test's stdout/stderr entirely, hiding real diagnostics (e.g. the unbound-variable abort above) and removing live suite progress
